Budget-friendly

Cabbage & Egg Skillet Rice

Cooked rice pan-fried with lightly browned cabbage, sweet carrots, and scrambled eggs. A fast, budget-friendly meal that makes excellent use of simple ingredients.

Estimated total
~20 min (starting from cooked rice)
Method
Skillet
Ingredients & Method ↓

Development edition · Awaits kitchen testing.

Ingredients Method Storage

Ingredients

How many people?
2

Estimated to serve 2 people as a main meal.

  • 300 g cooked rice, properly stored
    Time does not include cooking the rice.
  • 250 g thinly sliced cabbage
    Missing this?

    Use finely chopped broccoli · 250 g

    More crunch, less surface area for browning. Cooking may take longer. Cut thick stems very small so they cook evenly. Cook until tender-crisp before adding the rice.

  • 3 eggs
  • 1 small carrot, grated
  • 2 tsp neutral oil, divided
  • 1 garlic clove, minced
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce, plus more to taste
  • 2 sliced scallions (optional)

Contains egg and soy. Check all ingredient labels.

Method

You'll need
Large skillet · Cutting board · Chef's knife

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

This recipe requires pre-cooked rice that has been properly cooled and stored. The estimated 20 minutes does not include the time to cook the rice. Food safety guide

01

Scramble the eggs

Heat half the oil in a large skillet. Add the beaten eggs and stir until just set. Transfer to a plate and set aside.

Look for: Eggs are fully cooked with no runny parts left.

02

Brown the vegetables

Add the remaining oil to the skillet along with the cabbage and carrot. Let it sit undisturbed for a moment to develop some color, then stir. Stir in the garlic and cook briefly without burning it.

Look for: The cabbage has spots of golden brown while maintaining some crunch.

03

Combine and heat

Add the cooked rice, breaking up any clumps. Stir in the soy sauce and toss until everything is thoroughly heated. Return the eggs to the pan, breaking them up, and fold in the scallions if using.

Look for: The rice is hot and the grains are separate, not mushy.

Serve with

Serve hot directly from the skillet.

Storage & Prep ahead

This recipe uses leftover rice. Ensure the rice was cooled quickly and stored correctly before using.

Keep leftovers at 40°F (4°C) or colder. Refrigerate within 2 hours of preparation.
